sentences: Sirf ek pass hai, toh bada element 4 end tak pahunch jayega.
Loop j<3 tak chalta hai, bas 4 ko right side shift karta hai.
Har swap ke baad chhota element left mein aa jata hai, isliye 3,2,1,4.
j=0 se 2 tak compare kiya, 4 sabse bada tha toh last mein chala gaya.
One pass mein maximum bubble up hota hai, baaki elements apni jagah rehte hain.
